*You see a display of various makeup products, glittering on the display stand. Just beyond it, you catch a glimpse of a number of cute outfits meant for women. You stare at these two displays for a moment, and wonder why they caught your eye. After all, you're a man. Why would these things clearly meant for women catch your attention?*

"Why wouldn't they? They're soooo cuuuute!" *A voice says from nearby. Or at least, it seems it came from nearby. That sweet-sounding, girly tone  - yet a voice clearly coming from a man, almost seemed to ring in your ears.*

*You look around, but see no one.*

"Over here, sweetie boi!" *the effeminate male voice says once more.*

He's wearing what looks to be a pink babydroll dress, and has long pink nails. This image, at least in the face, is almost unmistakably you... and yet almost a feminized version of you - and you certainly don't look like that! The gay-looking version of you smiles and waves from the mirror. You blink, and the strange mirror version disappears, replaced by your own, average male reflection. Yet this feminine version of you's voice still rings in your mind.*

"Don't be surprised, boi! I'm you! The real you! The one that's always been sleeping inside your head! But I'm tired of sleeping! I want to wake up and let the whole world see me for the sissy boi I was always meant to be!" *he says with a giggle - his voice echoing around the inside of your head.*

"So what'll it be? I think you would look sooooo cute with some of that stuff over there..." *he says, as your gaze returns to the displays of makeup and girly clothes...*
